priorityList: Use Dragonrage on cooldown if the target will survive for at least 30 seconds.
Use Power Infusion, combat potions, and on-use trinkets during Dragonrage to maximize burst.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage to cast an instant Eternity Surge.
Cast Eternity Surge at Empower Level 1 as often as possible.
Cast Fire Breath at Empower Level 1 whenever the damage-over-time effect is refreshable.
Spend Essence and Essence Burst procs on Disintegrate as your primary spender.
Early-chain Disintegrate when 1 tick remains to maximize spell uptime.
Cast Living Flame immediately whenever the Burnout proc is active.
Cast Living Flame if the Ancient Flame or Leaping Flames buffs are active.
Cast Living Flame as your primary single-target filler spell.
Use Hover to maintain casting uptime during movement or if movement is expected within 6 seconds.
Use Verdant Embrace when Dragonrage is not active to trigger the Ancient Flame and Scarlet Adaptation buffs.
Cast Azure Strike as a filler only when moving if Hover is unavailable.
